note: The board-v2 films as data, from design/board-v2/films/. Durations are targets for drawing; the server's deadlines are the only clock. Not a rule and not an adopted contract.

audience.lighting: public: every phone and the display, every normal round, whether or not anyone asked for a strike
audience.line: public box: the window's line, a second row of the top bar from the window's opening until the lights start back, the same box on every phone and the display. It says "Remember who is where." in the lit preview and "Wait for the lights." in the dark on every screen but the eligible Disabler's, whose line is their own selection (owner-private). The top bar is above the board, so the line covers no position
audience.selection: owner-private: the eligible Disabler's own phone, in their bound room only
audience.outcome: public: the round's published batch (authorized hits only; a miss shows nothing anywhere)
audience.blocks: room-visible: a blocked strike is a miss in public; ATTACK BLOCKED (S4, films/blocked.mjs) plays only for its room's occupants, once the lights are back

films.clock: Milliseconds from the window's opening: previewEndsAt - 5000. Drawn from the trusted previewEndsAt and endsAt, never from a local start time.
notInputs: a request or its absence
a side (Blue or Red)
a selection
a viewer or audience
a role, a cause or a defense

beats.what: Numbered position markers fade in at every fixed slot of every room, empty ones included. The top bar shows the window's clock and, in a second row, its line
Lights on: figures, name tags and markers
Inside the lit preview: two dips of every room's light (4300-4420, 4650-4770) and each room's own light sparking at 4700, which light seeded by the window id. People stay on the page throughout

At previewEndsAt exactly, in both motion modes: every room cuts to its dark drawing; every figure, name tag and name leaves the page and the accessibility tree; markers turn dark; captions to 70%; the top bar's line says the dark's words. The selection opens in the same instant
Static dark, the half-open interval [previewEndsAt, endsAt). The eligible Disabler selects in their bound room
Dark until the outcome is published
At each authorized hit: the flash, the star, its rays; the hit room's art shakes 3 px for 160 ms. Nothing at a miss

Every room comes back together; people in their published state and place: a hit patient in the Hospital, at the slot the authoritative state gives, in the gown. The top bar's clock and line go as the lights start back
Markers fade out; the board is normal

reduced.what: No flicker, sparks, shake or travel. The same cut to the static dark at previewEndsAt, with a still bolt in each caption; 80 ms fades elsewhere: markers in at 0, one fade back at R; a still burst on each hit position for 600 ms

flashLimit.note: Counted over every second of the film; a flash's area is its bright part (a dip covers the board, which is why there are only two)

layers.L1: figures (hidden in the dark, not on the page)
layers.L3: each room's dark drawing over its art, clipped to the panel; sparks; impacts; markers
layers.L6: press areas: never moved, never shaken
layers.L10: top bar and navigation: never dimmed; the top bar carries the window's clock and line (public box; the eligible Disabler's line private)

audience.film: room-visible: only the occupants the server authorizes at the checkpoint, from the room fact it sends them. Never the display, the host or anyone outside the room: no banner, count or sound
audience.announcement: the same recipients, while the label is up: "Attack blocked on <name>." in a polite live region that every screen has and only theirs fills. It names the affected character only

films.clock: Milliseconds from the room fact's checkpoint. Played live only: never on a reconnect, never for a stale checkpoint.
inputs: the target's slot (where to draw it)
notInputs: the defense that blocked the attack, or its kind
the attacker or the kind of attack
a grantor
a count of blocks or of uses left
a direction

sizes.shield: 2.1 x the target's press side, centred on its press point
sizes.star: 1.6 x the press side, as a hit's

films.label: Centred on the press point, 2 px inside the panel and never over the room's caption: above the press area, else below the name tag; the two words stacked where one line is wider than the panel

beats.what: A source-free comic star at the chest (the press point), as a hit's: no direction or trail
The hexagonal shield flashes on and blooms from 0.8 to 1.05 of its size; the figure braces (2 px back), its art only
The ring expands and fades; eight symmetric particles scatter; the shield is spent
The figure is back in its authoritative pose. An Injured character stays Injured: bandage kept, no healing glow
ATTACK BLOCKED, caption yellow on ink: held 1600 ms, faded over 200 ms

reduced.what: A still ring and the label: in over 80 ms, held 1 600 ms, out over 80 ms. No star, bloom, brace or particles

films.blackout: In the Blackout a block is a miss on every screen but its room's occupants', whose film starts once the lights are fully back: R + 520 (reduced, R + 80)
films.several: Several blocks at one checkpoint each play on their own target, together
films.residue: Every node the film adds is removed when it ends; nothing is left on the page

layers.L4: the room-visible effects layer, clipped to the room's panel; mounted only for the authorized recipients
layers.L1: the brace moves the target's figure art only

audience.film: public: every phone and the shared display, the same; the pair, their entrance, the conversation scene and their exit are public (G-02; rules-contracts, Audiences and delivery)
audience.claim: participant-private, not part of this film: the declared side and its card stay in the two participants' own panel (design/phone-kit/js/hack.js), which the film never covers and never reads

films.clock: Milliseconds from the authoritative start of the stage (the result stage, the conversation, the conversation's end), from the server's deadlines; never a local start time and never an animation's end.
inputs: the public pair: two seat ids, ordered by player number (P1 the lower)
each participant's public place, health and detention, from the board (the latest authoritative)
the exchange's public id (the seated variations' seed)
notInputs: the declared side or the claim
which participant asked
who is speaking, a microphone or any sound
a role, a faction or a defense
an animation's completion

beats.what: Both participants outlined at their places in caption yellow, with the capsule's badge, once the projection names the pair
The outline and the badge (in by 300 ms); the private claim card on the participants' own phones is theirs, beside the board
Each stands (120 ms), steps toward the capsule's side and fades out of its room; its away marker comes up at its slot, which keeps its press area

The capsule's door slides open (1 250 to 1 550 ms). P1 comes in at 1 550 and walks behind the table to its chair (1 050 ms), P2 at 2 000 straight to its own (900 ms); each turns and sits (330 ms). The door slides shut (3 300 to 3 600 ms)
The door-status light lights. Settled, still, until the conversation starts: 1 400 ms to spare inside the stage

Both seated; quiet variations on a schedule seeded by the exchange's public id (lean in, sit back, a nod, an open hand, a hand at the chin, a blink), unrelated to speech; the top bar counts the conversation's server time down from 1:00

The light goes out and the door opens (300 ms); both stand (300 to 420 ms) and walk their paths back to the doorway, fading in it, P2 gone at 1 120 ms and P1 at 1 300; the door shuts (1 300 to 1 600 ms)

As each leaves the capsule it steps back in at its latest authoritative place, where the board has it now (600 ms), and settles into its gesture (330 ms); its away marker fades. Nothing waits for this

reduced.what: No walking, no steps, no variations. Result: the outline and badge; at 700 ms the people fade (80 ms) to their away markers and appear seated in the capsule, its door shown open until 1 100 ms, then shut and the light lit. Exit: the door shown open for 400 ms while the people fade (80 ms) from the capsule back to their places.

films.reconnect: Draws the stage's settled state at the current server time: in the result stage and the conversation, the pair seated, the door shut and its light lit, the away markers at their places; after it, everyone at their places and the capsule empty. The entrance and the exit are never replayed, and the minute is never restarted.
films.loading: Draws only the seats the public projection names: none, one or two. With none, the capsule as when idle (its door shut, its light off) under the stage's top bar; with one, that one's film alone. A seat named after its part began is drawn settled. Nobody is invented while a projection is awaited.

paths.units: scene units of the 512 x 768 capsule (its feet); the way out is the same path backward
paths.cadence: the approved public move's: 1.5 two-step cycles per 450 ms
paths.scale: the doorway's (0.9) in the doorway to the seat's (1.05) at the chairs, by depth

layers.capsule: its own panel beside the Command Room, exactly half its width (fit.mjs { capsule: true }); back, door, the participants, busy; no slots: its only targets are each seated participant's own seat (scenes/capsule.mjs capsuleTargets(), 44 px), as its slot is
layers.home: the participant's own room, its figure layer: the away marker at its slot; the step out is clipped to the room's panel
layers.tags: every name tag stays: at the slot, and under each seated participant in the capsule

films.audience: public: every phone and the display, from the public snapshot
films.clock: Loops on any clock, encoding nothing. The entry is milliseconds from the INJURY outcome, live only; it plays at the seat's own berth (its slotId).
inputs: the seat: location Hospital, health Injured, jailed, slotId
notInputs: an attacker, a healer or whoever registered a Rescue
a role, a side or a hidden cause
a receipt or a private command
a local countdown or the client's own observation of time
films.shows: The berth's monitor (unstable trace), its lamp (red while the due round is in progress, else amber, a slow pulse), the rescue tag on its plate ("R3" from rescueDueAfterRound; a struck cross for NO_ADDITIONAL_ROUND; none when CLOSED) and, for a detained patient, the neutral detention tag beside it. The patient keeps the gown and the injured pose; a faint breath on the figure's art only. The round is the server's; nothing counts down
films.tags: tagBox() (fx/medical.mjs): on the berth's plate, whole in the panel, never in the caption's band (the upper berths' tags go just below it) and never over a name tag (just below the one it would meet)

entry.what: The authorized transfer: the patient arrives in the berth (fades in) as the monitor boots, then the lamp comes on and the tag pops in, at the seat's own berth

films.reduced: Static: the trace, the lamp and the tag, faded in over 80 ms on admission; no breath, no pulse
films.body: An Eliminated patient's monitor and lamp are off and its bed light down; nothing is added for an empty berth

films.audience: public: every phone and the display, from the MEDICAL_OUTCOME kind HEALED event (alone, or after INJURY in the same batch); live only, never on a reconnect or for an expired event
films.clock: Milliseconds from the outcome's presentation start; 5600 ms (reduced 1760 ms). Nonblocking and cancelable: the board, the timer and the navigation stay usable; the film stops at once and draws nothing more when a newer snapshot moves its subject or another seat into its berth, or when the Blackout's window (S1) owns the board, which then shows the latest snapshot.
inputs: the berth: the outcome's presentationAnchor (HVn names berth Hn) and the snapshot's slots (filmBerth())
the subject's public character, clothes and detention, from the snapshot
notInputs: an attacker, a healer or whoever registered a Rescue
a role, a side or a hidden cause
a receipt or a private command
a local countdown or the client's own observation of time

where.berth: filmBerth(): the berth the anchor names, unless another seat holds that slot in the published snapshot (a patient admitted in the same batch can take the berth the subject left); then no film is drawn and the outcome's announcement stands alone, as Backend's CLINICAL_VIGNETTE rule asks
where.subject: At its own berth the snapshot's figure is hidden while the film draws it there; anywhere else the snapshot's figure is marked away (grey) and its name tag is carried to the berth for the film, so it is never drawn in two places
where.inset: insetBox() (fx/medical.mjs): above the berth's press area, else below its name tag, else in the band beside the caption; never over the caption, the berth's own press area or a press area another seat holds; else no inset, and the berth's monitor shows the trace alone
where.drone: droneFit() (fx/medical.mjs): drawn smaller, to half its size at least, where the caption or another seat's press area is above the berth, so that it covers neither; its probes stay on the chest
where.several: Several clinical outcomes in one batch play at once, each at its own berth; each inset keeps clear of the insets placed before it (keepClear), in the batch's event order

films.words: None of the film's own: the client's announcement of the authoritative outcome (today the hosted board's "Player 2: Healed." or "Player 2: Eliminated.", #154). announce marks the beat at which the picture shows the change, for a client that times its words to the film as it does ATTACK BLOCKED's; said once either way

beats.what: The berth's lamp blinks amber twice; the vitals inset opens on the unstable trace
The drone leaves the Hospital's ceiling dock and comes down over the bed, arms tucked, hovering
Its three arms unfold over the bed
A scan line goes down the patient and back under a faint diagnostic hologram
The probes and the lens charge
One controlled revival pulse at the chest; the patient reacts (2.5 px, its art only)
The trace steadies, the lamp calms, the patient sits up: Injured to Healthy, in the gown, the detention tag kept
Arms tucked, the drone goes back up to its dock; the inset closes. The board then shows the snapshot: the patient in their room, or in the Jail if detained

reduced.what: No travel, flash or jolt: the drone still over the bed and the inset fade in over 80 ms; at 800 ms the trace steadies, the lamp calms and the patient sits up; out over 80 ms

films.origin: The Hospital's ceiling dock, whoever registered the Rescue: it never comes from anyone's room or points to anyone
films.never: An Eliminated patient is never revived: the film plays only for a HEALED outcome of an Injured patient

films.audience: public: every phone and the display, from the MEDICAL_OUTCOME kind DEATH event; live only
films.clock: Milliseconds from the outcome's presentation start; 4200 ms (reduced 1760 ms). It plays after the authorized outcome and never causes it. Nonblocking and cancelable: the board, the timer and the navigation stay usable; the film stops at once and draws nothing more when a newer snapshot moves its subject or another seat into its berth, or when the Blackout's window (S1) owns the board, which then shows the latest snapshot.

beats.what: The inset opens: the heartbeat slows and thins; the lamp pulses red once a second; the patient's breath fades until it lies still
The trace goes flat; the lamp holds red; the Hospital's light dips to 0.72 of its brightness, never dark
The equipment powers down: the trace collapses to a dot, the lamp and the bed light go out; the patient lies still (Eliminated)
The room's light returns; the inset closes. The body stays where the snapshot has it, its equipment off

reduced.what: No dip or pulse: the inset with the flat trace and the patient still fade in over 80 ms; at 800 ms the screen and the lamp go off; out over 80 ms

films.never: No local countdown, timer or animation kills a patient or shortens a rescue opportunity: the server's deadline does, and its DEATH outcome comes first; a death's cause is never shown
